description: This file defines a page component for editing a note in a note-taking application. It imports API functions to fetch notes and a specific note by ID, as well as several UI components. The component asynchronously fetches data and renders a UI with header, sidebar, and an editing client component.

methods.name: EditNotePage
methods.description: Main React component for the 'Edit Note' page, asynchronously fetching note data and rendering layout.
